display_name: Jacked and Coke (Karubo's bar, Vista del Rey)
why: Jacked and Coke is a civilian dive bar. Owner decision 63 removes Karubo and retains the bartender; venue-node-policy section 1 removes the gang garrison.

open_questions: Check the front door on Pigeon & Congress opens. It is #rey_08_front_door, which vanilla only powers through the gig's prestate branch that never runs; the runtime door policy may not see it because its path is unresolved. If it is sealed, note its position so it can be added to the door scope.

Check the bar sign shows the open state. LocationSign_var 1 is the value vanilla uses once the bar is open for the gig; if the sign instead shows a closed, boarded or 'for lease' variant, report it so the toggle flips to 0.
Check the bar is staffed and busy when you walk in. Expect the Valentino bartender behind the bar and eight Valentinos on the rail, wall, barstool, music spot and tablet, all neutral and relaxed.
Check Karubo is alive, at his bar and calm. Expect Character.sts_hey_rey_08_karubo on the routine dirt stand spot near the bar, with no contract, holocall or hostile reaction.
Check there is no police aftermath outside. Expect no NCPD inspectors, no police car and no crime-scene tape or markers in front of the bar (after_sts 0).

Check the pavement outside still has its ambient crowd. The default-on #sts_hey_rey_08_openworld_com (two Valentinos plus three patrons) should be present without this venue activating it; if the corner is empty, the lead should add the whole-community activation.

Check the back rooms are intact but not the way in. The Technical Ability back door should still work, the storage rooms should hold no bodies or gig props, and the kitchen window route should read as normal bar clutter.

communities.why: Owner decision 63 retains the ordinary bartender; venue-node-policy section 1 excludes the combat-role regulars from this civilian venue.

variant_toggles.why: Keeps the normal, before-anything-happened state of the open-world section. after_sts 1 is the post-gig variant the open-world phase applies once rey_08_finished is set, which dresses the hit's aftermath; our timeline never runs the hit.

The bar's open-for-business sign. Vanilla's prestate leaves the venue shut (sign 0, all doors unpowered and closed) and switches to sign 1 together with powering the doors once the street story becomes available at tier 1_2; with no gig in our timeline the bar keeps that later, open state all the time.

proximity_wait.why: The bar's street door on Pigeon & Congress is the first device a player reaches, it is a DoorControllerPS (rule 8, never a workspot), and it is the door vanilla's prestate seals and then powers to open the bar.
